title: Quartic Class Number Projection
objective: Optimize the authenticated resumable quartic class-number-only path and reuse bounded Minkowski state without duplicating proof-object construction

handoff.summary: Implemented and integrated an ordinary-Python authenticated quartic class-number projection that carries one bounded Minkowski factor base and exact relation prefix into the general engine, pauses after exact saturation for scalar-only requests, and constructs deferred proof objects only when a class group is requested. The five-field, two-proof-mode benchmark passed with geometric-mean new/old scalar wall ratio 0.688785; the real h=2 quartic improved by about 3.4x, x^4+2 improved by 24-28%, and every route preserved exact output and detached replay. Frozen source commit 9ea52d6781c99c06c768beaaef556c7b12e7c530 has focused, strict, architecture (after the integration-owned ratchet), and full native coverage.
risks: The complex h=2 discriminant-2889 control is intentionally near-neutral at 1.012-1.039x rather than faster, but remains below the 1.10 per-case regression gate.

The cumulative changed suite reached two pre-existing standalone FLINT compiler-fixture failures and two pre-existing checkpoint-resume assertions; the checkpoint failures reproduce identically on detached exact base d3e81c7b, while the frozen source full native suite passes.

A later class-group request still pays authenticated certificate and public proof materialization; this change optimizes the scalar request and reuses its mathematical state rather than weakening later replay.
next_steps: Extend the benchmark to a stratified higher-discriminant quartic corpus and use phase counters to choose the next generic policy boundary.
Profile the remaining first class-group materialization and detached-replay cost against PARI after the scalar fast path, without adding compiler/native code absent a measured limitation.
